acceptanceCriteria.text: One function/CLI-testable adapter converts an exact published/generated Review Pages revision into bounded structured AI-review input.
Repository/PR/base/head identity and source-resource provenance survive unchanged.
Issue intent, diff inventory, OCR output and checks are represented without duplicating their semantics.
Missing/partial resources are explicit rather than silently dropped.
Raw source bodies, CI logs and broad repository scans are excluded.
Fixed fixture input produces deterministic output.
Tests cover complete, partial and malformed revision packages.
Reviewer/LLM execution is not implemented here.

issue.title: feat: assemble bounded AI review input from Review Pages evidence
